TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Heavy rainfall, high winds and excess water on the roads are creating hazardous driving conditions across central and eastern Newfoundland. 

Due to the increased risk of hydroplaning and other traffic hazards, police are asking all drivers to reduce speeds, increase following distance to other vehicles and avoid sudden braking.

Please plan ahead and drive according to the current weather and road conditions.

data.text:
Good morning from Davao, Philippines. As Pastor Barry and I prepare to teach the entire Book of Daniel in just a couple of hours, I am once again reminded of the faithfulness, grace, and above all, the mercies of God.

Exactly 28 years ago, while driving from Davao to speak at a conference in Cagayan de Oro, the Lord preserved my life. A terrible car accident occurred when a fully loaded trailer truck failed to yield and merged into traffic, leaving us no time to brake. We crashed into the truck and were dragged underneath the trailer. When I later saw the photos of the wrecked vehicle, I could not believe that anyone could have survived.

But God.

Yes, ever since that day I have carried a thorn in my flesh in the form of chronic lower back pain. Yet I am alive, I am well, and I am deeply grateful and blessed to be able to teach His Word today.

profile_bio.description: Bible Teacher | Three-time New York Times Bestselling Author| Conference Speaker | Middle East News Commentator | Founder & President of Behold Israel
